scope: Read-only startup input and static post-run-auditor compatibility review; no physical task success is inferred.
configuration_serialization_note: The launch config hash differs from run/config.json because run.py serializes the parsed configuration with json.dumps(indent=2), without its source trailing newline. Parsed objects are compared for exact equality.

auditor_static_review.observed_behavior: The staged audit follows candidate/rejected status, actual executed phase order, timestamps, original rotation, bounded displacement, observed endpoints, continuous original contact guard, and native hand-height evidence. It does not turn saved section heuristic violations into physical failures. Final success also requires frozen validate.py task_success, native reaction audit, full sequence completion, no runtime error, richer held-handle and per-link wrench audits, and matching frozen inputs.
auditor_static_review.limitation: Static code review only; no full16 post-run traces yet exist and no GPU execution was performed by this reviewer.

limitations: External robot mesh hashes are measured at this review, not established as startup hashes.
The input manifest covers scene source/config/copied assets, not installed Genesis/libuipc binaries or all environment dependencies.
Hash consistency proves recorded inputs match the manifest; it does not prove physical correctness or task success.
